cases.assertion_intent: Every shipped native Go source file, including test source, is actually parsed; malformed-source controls must be rejected.
cases.adaptation: Python ast.parse is replaced by Go parser checks of actual package sources. It is not a statement-by-statement translation of Python grammar; equivalent native source-parse coverage and malformed controls run on the declared minimum Go toolchain.
cases.oracle: Original source test intent and declared go.mod version; Go parser/language/API negative controls plus exact declared minimum-toolchain full native test execution.

cases.assertion_intent: The package does not use language or standard-library features newer than its declared minimum language version; the exact minimum compiler must build/test all native packages.
cases.adaptation: The source-specific Python f-string restriction becomes the Go promise in go.mod. Native version-aware checks include negative controls for newer syntax and standard-library APIs; a separate hash-verified real Go1.25.0 full test run is mandatory, and a newer local compiler cannot substitute for it.
